consumer: A dialogue/condition possession check (conditional_t::set_has_item, the u_has_item/npc_has_item lambda) asking 'does the player personally carry the detonator?', whose boolean result an engine condition EVALUATES.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded weapon + worn + inventory), excluding nearby reachable containers
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1) over the Character actor, i.e. an engine-computed yes/no scoped to that character's own items; crafting_inventory in mission.cpp::is_complete is the WRONG reach (it includes nearby items).
divergence: The detonator sits only in a crate on an adjacent tile (reachable nearby, not worn/wielded/in inventory): the on-person predicate must return false, but a crafting_inventory/find-item-scoped answer would wrongly return true.
